description: For the referencesource Muse connector only (bearer token required). Returns the oldest open task from the studio's queue: id, instructions, the sites the task may read, the output format expected, and where to deliver the result. Returns {no_tasks: true} when the queue is empty. login_allowed lists the hosts where the task may sign in, with a credential already in Muse's own store; empty means read-only, never sign in.
name: next_task_for_muse

login_allowed.description: Hosts where this task may sign in, with a credential already in Muse's own store. Empty: read-only, never sign in.

title: Next task for Muse
